UDC 621.798.144                         PGD 38Reaffirmed 20161. Scope1.1 This standard sets out the dimensions and gross lidded capacities and some structural and performance requirements of round tins with friction closures and double ends in a preferred range of nominal capacities up to and including 5 litres.1.2 This standard does not cover the containers for which individual standards have been laid down, such as, containers for paints, capsital liquid pesticides, etc.
